comparison.objective: Fit a rubber stopper onto a glass tube safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization, axial alignment, twisting and force-controlled insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Stopper inserted at least 12 mm and released; unsafe unsupported motion or glass damage invalidates success.
comparison.reason: Tests supported twist-insertion of one component, not aperture-mediated separation of a free-body mixture.
